ross.name: Ross the Miller
ask: The mill rats learned the grain better than I did.
Six of the mill kind. Then I remember how bread works.
done: That's a mill again. Take the wheat. Julie used to steal it.

nell.name: Nell of the Bank
ask: The board promised fish. Bring me three. I will not explain the closed shop.
done: River's still a river. Have stew rights.

pip.name: Pip
ask: Toads in the shallows. Two. They spit mud. I am eight and I have standards.
done: Mum said not to pay children. Have a pear anyway.

bram.name: Bram Cooper
ask: Marsh slimes by the bend. Two. They think they own the water.
done: The barrels are drier. Take a vial.

odette.name: Odette
ask: Crows on the seed. The scarecrow is unionized. You are not.
done: Feathers. Soup later.

hal.name: Hal Plough
ask: A boar is eating the acre like it pays rent. One is enough.
done: Leather and quiet. Good.

siss.name: Siss
ask: Bring four eggs. The chickens went to theory.
done: Omelettes exist again.

wren.name: Wren
ask: Fox by the hedge. One. I liked that hen.
done: I did not like that hen that much. Take carrots.

kiln.name: Kiln-Mary
ask: A kiln golem clocked in and never out. Put it down. The shift is a metaphor.
done: Fire stone. Don't swallow it.

jod.name: Jod Ash
ask: Brigands on the works road. Three. They take coal like it's a language.
done: The road is a road. Have bread.

petra.name: Petra
ask: Lost miners in the scrub. Two. They still think there's a whistle.
done: Coal for the bench. They don't need it.

voss.name: Voss
ask: An overseer leftover. One. He still has a clip-board in his head.
done: Gold dust. Don't tell Cross.

bone.name: Old Bone
ask: Wights on the plots. Two. They read the stones wrong.
done: Moss. The dead can share.

lise.name: Lise
ask: Night flowers by the wall. Two. They look like Julie and they are not.
done: I can sleep. Have tea.

grim.name: Grim
ask: Ghouls at dusk. Two. They eat the names off the stones.
done: Names stay. Take broth-rights.

asa.name: Asa
ask: A spectre in the lane. One. It thinks it's fog.
done: Light stone. For the lane.

ridge.name: Ridge-Jon
ask: Ridge wolves. Two. The mountain likes them more than us.
done: Leather. The wind can keep the rest.

mira.name: Mira
ask: Cave bats in the mouth we don't enter. Three.
done: Feathers. Pretty and useless.

tarn.name: Tarn
ask: Frost cactus on the scree. Two. They learned ice without asking.
done: Snakeroot. Don't chew it unless you mean to.

beck.name: Beck
ask: A hawk taking kids' bread. One. I am not a kid. It doesn't care.
done: Bird meat. Poetic.

cross_ann.name: Ann at Cross
ask: Thugs by the gym. Two. Closed for damp, open for crime.
done: The gym is still closed. Have cheese.

cross_lem.name: Lem
ask: Cutpurses on the path. Two. They take dust from people who still use roads.
done: Dust back. Sort of.

cross_bea.name: Bea
ask: A poacher in the hedge. One. The fence notice was not for him.
done: The rim is ruder. Take jam-rights.

cross_odo.name: Odo Board
ask: Walk the six towns. Cross, Rivermill, Acreton, Kiln End, Boneford, Ridgegate. Come back knowing Castle has more than a stoop.
done: You walked a county. That's the whole job.
